messages:
marta (partnerships): quick sync — ACME SI reported duplicated usage on replayed offline batches. suspect idempotency key mismatch when usage_bridge receives both kafka-replay and realtime. attaching sample payload.

john (ACME SI): correct — our retry logic replays with same usage_id but different envelope_id. here's what we send:
```
{
  "usage_id": "usr-1234",
  "envelope_id": "env-202406",
  "timestamp": "2024-06-02T15:12:00Z",
  "sku": "redwood-small-gen",
  "units": 120
}
```

sanjay (eng-platform): thanks. on our side the dedupe key is `usage_id||partner_id||window_start`. envelope_id wasn't considered.

kevin (billing): that's the problem — partner might change envelope_id on replay. propose we accept `usage_id` as primary dedupe and have a 48h replay window plus tombstone records.

elaine (product): agree on 48h. also need to version contract v2 to explicitly call out `usage_id` permanence. we'll send a change note to ACME.

marta (partnerships): action items: 1) eng to add optional envelope_id ignore fallback, 2) billing to define tombstone behavior, 3) partnerships to notify partners about v2. who's volunteering for 1?

sanjay (eng-platform): i'll take 1 — plan: patch usage_bridge to fallback to usage_id dedupe and emit a metric `usage.dedupe.fallback` when envelope != seen.

kevin (billing): i'll draft tombstone retention policy: tombstones kept 7d, soft-delete after 30d, and a reconcile job for >7d duplicates.

john (ACME SI): we'll backfill with a flag `replay=true` on the envelope so you can trust envelope changes during initial migration. can you add a `replay` param to schema?

marta (partnerships): ok — putting replay param in contract v2. @marketplace-bot can you post the updated webhook schema doc link?

marketplace-bot: New doc published: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/webhooks#v2 — schema shows `usage_id` required, `replay` optional, `envelope_id` optional.

sanjay (eng-platform): quick note — integration test command:
```
./tools/integration_test --partner acme --schema v2 --replay
```
works locally. will open PR with tests and a small migration plan.

elaine (product): also product: we'll surface a CSV download in console for partners to check accepted vs rejected rows.

marta (partnerships): thanks all. i'll run a partners sync 9am PT tomorrow with ACME to confirm. will post minutes.
